title: Coles Finest Luxury Blueberry Sorbet 500mL $3.50 (was $7) @ Coles
body:
Deal: Coles Finest Luxury Blueberry Sorbet 500mL $3.50 (was $7) @ Coles

[Slo20] It’s showing $3.50 for me. I set to Adelaide street as example.
[Slo20] Strange. When I set to “Coles carindale (Westfield)” it still Shows as half price
[Slo20] @Lizard Spock: I wasn’t logged in but was using the app. But when I change it from instore to delivered or click-and-collect the price goes back to $7.
[Lizard Spock] @Slo20: Ah, I see, that's what I was doing, selecting delivered.
[b4rg] Thanks is that the only flavour in that range half price please?
This one reduced to clear.. so going to be discontinued?
Dairy free too
Wish they’d use names rather than numbers haha
Citric acid, Guar gum and xanthum gum for anyone who is sensitive or has digestive issues :(
[Embaloo] Yep i havent seen any of the other in the rqnge discounted. Thanks for that
[cheepy] At my Coles it says $7, but when you scan the price with the Coles App it was $3.50. From Melbourne btw.
[safrane] As long as you set your Coles app to "in-store" instead of CnC/delivery, you'll see the clearance price (and whether or not it's in stock).
[Ttbblsd] I purchased 2 weeks ago, 3.5 each. They were marked as "reduced to clear". After tasting one of them, I know why.
[John Doh] Thanks, saved me $3.5 and a few forced calories.
[Embaloo] Not a fan? I'm tempted to make my own after trying this. Have the gums, just not sure if my aldi machine can get it so creamy. The texture is right on point imo.
[capslock janitor] unav. online
but nice to see coles updated with stock checker unsure how accurate it is showing available
[Wt133] It seems very weird they can’t make much of anything in Australia. It’s cheaper to make it overseas and ship it into the country. Happens with many other items
[Towels] Never been a blueberry man, i like apple.
